item.text:
**Verdict**: mixed but leaning negative. I found limited 2024 procedural positives around localized election observation, but the stronger 2024 record shows coercive entrenchment through emergency powers, opposition/journalist arrests, media and civic-space restrictions, and a security apparatus operating outside normal legal controls.

**Accepted claims**
- **Freedom in the World 2025 Country Report** | Freedom House | 2025 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/ethiopia/freedom-world/2025 | The report says Abiy-era electoral-law and NEBE reforms improved electoral operations and that some June 2024 legislative/regional elections were peaceful and credible according to AU observers. This is limited positive evidence against outright electoral manipulation, but it is procedural and narrow. | `4B.2`, `4B.1`
- **Final Observation Report On The Outstanding And Reelections Of The Sixth General Elections Held In Benishangul Gumuz, Afar, Somali And Central Ethiopia Regions In June 24 2024** | CECOE | 2024 | https://cecoe.org/download/final-observation-report-on-the-outstanding-and-reelections-of-the-sixth-general-elections-held-in-benishangul-gumuz-afar-somali-and-central-ethiopia-regions-in-june-24-2024/ | Domestic observers described the June 24, 2024 reruns as transparent enough for systematic observation, with broad observer deployment and monitoring of polling, counting, and the post-election environment. That is positive but limited evidence that not every 2024 electoral process was manipulated to entrench the ruler. | `4B.2`, `4B.1`
- **World Report 2024: Ethiopia** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-12 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/ethiopia | HRW says authorities restricted social media, arrested opposition figures and journalists, and used emergency powers in a way that narrowed political space. That points against refraining from using state power to entrench incumbency. | `4B.2`, `4B.1`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`
- **Ethiopia’s Deepening Crackdown on Dissent** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-03-04 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/04/ethiopias-deepening-crackdown-dissent | HRW reported the arrest of an opposition spokesperson and a journalist, plus broad arbitrary detention under emergency powers. This is direct evidence of coercive suppression rather than clean, competitive politics. | `4B.2`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`
- **In Ethiopia, a secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels** | Reuters via EHRC | 2024-02-27 | https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/ | Reuters reported a secret security committee that interfered in the justice system and was linked to widespread rights violations. That is strong evidence of security-force use for political control outside ordinary legal channels. | `4B.2`, `3B.9`
- **The state-of-emergency proclamation** | ENA English | 2024-11-03 | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/en_30124 | The proclamation centralized coercive authority, empowered an operation command, restricted CSOs and media suspected of aiding “terrorist” groups, imposed ID/movement controls, and suspended normal judicial handling of enforcement. That looks like entrenchment through emergency rule, not restraint. | `4B.2`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`
- **Ethiopia authorities suspend three rights groups** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-12-02 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups | HRW says the government suspended three rights groups while Abiy praised reforms on media freedom and NGO registration. The operational pattern is selective punishment of civic actors, not neutral respect for contestable politics. | `4B.2`, `3B.8`
- **Ethiopia: Journalist arrested under state of emergency: Belay Manaye** | Amnesty International | 2024-03-14 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/afr25/7782/2024/en/ | Amnesty says a journalist was detained under emergency powers for reporting on the Amhara conflict. That is evidence of using security law to chill media and political scrutiny. | `4B.2`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`
- **Ethiopia - Civicus Monitor** | CIVICUS Monitor | 2024-12-04 | https://monitor.civicus.org/press_release/2024/ethiopia/ | CIVICUS downgraded civic space to “Closed,” citing surveillance, harassment, intimidation, and threats against journalists and opposition members. That is incompatible with a ruler refraining from manipulative entrenchment. | `4B.2`, `3B.8`

**Search gap**
- 2024 was not a full national-election year in Ethiopia, so direct evidence on campaign-time manipulation of a general election is sparse.
- I did not find a strong 2024 Reuters or primary-source report showing Abiy explicitly admitted manipulating electoral rules, courts, or public resources.
- The best positive evidence is procedural and localized, from observer reports on June 2024 reruns, while the best negative evidence is broader repression and emergency-rule use that clearly advantages incumbency.
